skills.name: TypeSafe
skills.description: Use when building AI-powered decision systems that need structured, typed answers instead of generated text. Reach for TypeSafe when you need to classify content, score items on a rubric, answer yes/no questions, route requests, or compose multiple judgments into complex workflows. Ideal for support ticket triage, content moderation, intent routing, risk assessment, and any system where your code needs to act on AI decisions directly.
